encouraging: The feed was built never to end. You were not.
Every minute here was paid for with your life. Was it worth the price?
Someone engineered this to keep you. Leave anyway.
Whatever you came here to escape is still waiting for you.
"Just ten more minutes" is how whole years disappear.
No one will remember what you scrolled past. They will remember what you did.
Your attention is your life. Stop giving it away for free.
You will not find what you are looking for in the next post.

quotes.text: How we spend our days is, of course, how we spend our lives.
quotes.author: Annie Dillard

quotes.text: Tell me, what is it you plan to do with your one wild and precious life?
quotes.author: Mary Oliver

quotes.text: Attention is the beginning of devotion.
quotes.author: Mary Oliver

quotes.text: Attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity.
quotes.author: Simone Weil

quotes.text: My experience is what I agree to attend to.
quotes.author: William James
quotes.source: The Principles of Psychology, ch. 11, Attention

quotes.text: The cost of a thing is the amount of what I will call life which is required to be exchanged for it, immediately or in the long run.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.text: All of humanity's misery comes from one thing: not knowing how to stay quietly in a room.
quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.text: Such as are thy habitual thoughts, such also will be the character of thy mind; for the soul is dyed by the thoughts.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: You could leave life right now. Let that determine what you do and say and think.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Do not act as if thou wert going to live ten thousand years. Death hangs over thee. While thou livest, while it is in thy power, be good.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: It is not that we have a short space of time, but that we waste much of it.
quotes.author: Seneca
quotes.source: On the Shortness of Life 1, trans. Basore

quotes.text: While we are postponing, life speeds by.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Nothing, Lucilius, is ours, except time.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Hold every hour in your grasp.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: Every habit and faculty is confirmed and strengthened by the corresponding actions, that of walking by walking, that of running by running.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: We are spinning our own fates, good or evil, and never to be undone.
quotes.author: William James
quotes.source: The Principles of Psychology, ch. 4, Habit

quotes.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
quotes.author: Will Durant
quotes.source: The Story of Philosophy (1926), summarizing Aristotle

quotes.text: We become just by doing just acts, temperate by doing temperate acts, brave by doing brave acts.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.text: Character is destiny.
quotes.author: Heraclitus

quotes.text: Life can only be understood backwards; but it must be lived forwards.
quotes.author: Søren Kierkegaard
quotes.source: Journals, 1843, condensed rendering listed by Wikiquote

quotes.text: Real generosity toward the future consists in giving all to the present.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.text: The life which is unexamined is not worth living.
quotes.author: Socrates
